## Normative Datasets (generated, not committed)

Large normative reference datasets are generated by running:

```bash
julia --project=. test/tools/collect_normative_datasets.jl
```

The script downloads records from PhysioNet, extracts HRV features, and stores
results under `test/testdata/<dataset_name>/`.  Files under `_cache` and `_downloads` are **not committed**.

### Output Structure (per dataset)

```
test/testdata/<dataset>/
  metadata.toml                       ← Registry info + collection run provenance
  participant_features.csv            ← One row per participant, all features
  windowed_w60_s30_features.csv       ← Windowed features (default: 60-beat window, 30-beat stride)
  _downloads/                         ← Raw downloaded files (can be deleted after collection)
  _cache/                             ← Per-record intermediate results (used for --skip-existing)
```

### Normative Evaluation (4σ rule)

```julia
using CSV, DataFrames, Statistics

df = CSV.read("test/testdata/nsrdb/participant_features.csv", DataFrame)

# Compute normative ranges per feature
feature_cols = setdiff(names(df), ["participant_id", "dataset", "n_beats", "recording_ok"])
μ = map(c -> mean(skipmissing(df[!, c])), feature_cols)
σ = map(c -> std( skipmissing(df[!, c])), feature_cols)

# Evaluate a new measurement
new_val = Dict("sdnn" => 42.0, "rmssd" => 35.0)
for (i, feat) in enumerate(feature_cols)
    haskey(new_val, feat) || continue
    z = abs(new_val[feat] - μ[i]) / σ[i]
    z > 4 && @warn "Feature $feat is outside 4σ normative range (z=$(round(z; digits=2)))"
end
```

### Registered Datasets

| Folder | Source | Population | Format | N Records |
|--------|--------|------------|--------|-----------|
| `nsrdb` | [NSRDB](https://physionet.org/content/nsrdb/) | healthy | WFDB | 18 |
| `mitbih` | [MIT-BIH](https://physionet.org/content/mitdb/) | mixed | WFDB | 48 |
| `nsr2db` | [NSR2DB](https://physionet.org/content/nsr2db/) | healthy | txt | 52 |
| `meditation` | [Meditation](https://physionet.org/content/meditation/) | healthy | WFDB | 16 |
| `challenge2002` | [Challenge 2002](https://physionet.org/content/challenge-2002/) | mixed | txt | 20 |
| `chaos` | [Chaos HR](https://physionet.org/content/chaos-heart-rate/) | healthy | txt | 10 |
| `mvtdb` | [MVTDB](https://physionet.org/content/mvtdb/) | arrhythmia | WFDB | 10 |

To add more datasets, edit the `DATASET_REGISTRY` constant in
`test/tools/collect_normative_datasets.jl`.
